events.description: A large group of people, many wearing yellow vests, are gathered on a wide boulevard (Champs-Élysées) with the Arc de Triomphe in the background; a vehicle or structure is engulfed in intense flames and thick black smoke, debris is scattered across the street, and individuals are actively moving around the fire and confronting authorities, indicating collective violent unrest.

A large fire burns in the street with thick black smoke, surrounded by a crowd of people, many wearing yellow vests, moving actively around the blaze; this constitutes collective violent unrest consistent with a riot.

Sustained violent unrest on a street with thick smoke (likely from tear gas or burning debris), individuals moving through smoke, and apparent deployment of crowd-control measures; consistent with an ongoing riot.
Two individuals in close physical contact in frame f10–f13: one in yellow vest appears to grapple or push another person who is bent over; motion suggests mutual physical struggle amid smoke.

A street scene filled with thick white and black smoke, debris on the road including a zebra crossing, and individuals in yellow vests moving through the smoke; consistent with ongoing violent unrest or protest-related clashes.

At approximately 33.5–34.5 seconds, two individuals in yellow vests appear to engage in physical contact: one is bent over while the other appears to push or grapple with them, suggesting mutual physical combat amid the smoke.

Sustained violent unrest involving police deploying water cannon against protesters, with visible smoke/tear gas, debris on ground, and individuals in yellow vests engaging in confrontational actions including lifting and throwing a large concrete block.
Group of individuals in yellow vests physically struggle to lift and hurl a large concrete barrier toward police; involves coordinated physical exertion and direct confrontation with law enforcement.

A large group of people wearing yellow vests are engaged in violent unrest on a city street, with visible smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades) being deployed and individuals running, ducking, and raising hands in response. The crowd is dense, chaotic, and moving rapidly, indicating collective violent unrest.

A water cannon is actively deployed against the crowd, spraying high-pressure water across the street, causing debris (including a toppled kiosk/structure) to be scattered and further escalating the violent confrontation.

Sustained use of water cannons against a group of individuals in yellow vests, with debris (metal barriers, containers) overturned and smoke/steam filling the street; police or security personnel visible in background engaging with protesters.
Large group of individuals in yellow vests advancing through heavy smoke, some carrying or pushing a large white container/trailer; scene suggests ongoing confrontation or mobilization during unrest.

A violent confrontation between protesters wearing yellow vests and riot police in full protective gear, involving deployment of tear gas (visible as white smoke at 103.0–103.5s), projectiles on the ground, and dynamic movement suggesting clashes.

Multiple individuals in yellow vests and police officers are engaged in close physical confrontations; some officers advance with batons/shields while protesters appear to push back or throw objects, consistent with mutual physical combat in a crowd setting.

A police officer in riot gear is escorting a person wearing a yellow vest and red pants, who appears restrained (hands behind back or held), along a sidewalk amid onlookers. The person being escorted shows no active resistance but is under physical control.

Multiple officers in full riot gear are carrying a person wearing a yellow vest horizontally, suggesting the individual is incapacitated or being forcibly removed. The person’s limbs appear limp, and there is no indication of voluntary movement or resistance.

Two police officers in riot gear are physically restraining and escorting a person wearing a yellow vest; the individual appears passive and is being handled forcefully, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim during arrest.

Ongoing street unrest with smoke visible in background (f0–f1), multiple individuals in yellow vests, police in riot gear, and scattered debris on the road; collective violent disorder is evident beyond isolated arrest.

A large crowd of people, many wearing yellow vests, is gathered on a Parisian street with the Arc de Triomphe visible in the background; smoke or tear gas is being deployed, and police in riot gear are present, indicating collective violent unrest.

A shirtless man raises his arm aggressively toward another individual in a black hooded jacket who appears to be recoiling or shielding; physical contact is not clearly visible but the posture suggests an imminent or ongoing physical confrontation.
A street scene with smoke/tear gas deployed, people dispersing, and police in riot gear present; consistent with an active riot or protest escalation.
A shirtless man is being physically restrained and guided by a police officer in riot gear; the man appears non-resisting but is being handled forcefully, suggesting potential abuse during arrest.

A group of protesters wearing yellow and orange vests are gathered on a wide urban street, with smoke (likely from flares or tear gas) visible in the background and foreground. Multiple individuals are holding and igniting red flares, raising arms, and moving dynamically; the scene shows collective unrest with signs of escalation (e.g., flare use, smoke, protective gear like helmets and masks). The Arc de Triomphe is visible in the distance, indicating a Paris location consistent with Yellow Vest protests. No clear evidence of direct physical combat, but the behavior constitutes violent unrest.
